data.disagreement_analysis: The qwen model failed on its second PKGBUILD review pass due to an API error (HTTP 400 BadRequestError), resulting in an inconclusive verdict. However, it did successfully complete an initial PKGBUILD audit that found it safe. The deepseek model successfully reviewed all files and found them safe. coverage_issues: qwen model experienced API error (HTTP 400) on second PKGBUILD review pass, preventing completion of full audit
learnings: Tool errors (API failures, timeouts) should be handled gracefully - the qwen model's initial PKGBUILD audit was successful and should have been sufficient for verdict

When a model completes an initial audit successfully but fails on a secondary pass, the initial audit results should be preserved and used for the final verdict rather than marking the entire file as inconclusive
Distinguish between tool failures and genuine security disagreements - API errors should not trigger re-audits or escalate to inconclusive when substantive review was already completed
